scope: All four enumerated ordinary Feet/0 fittings separately corrected/reviewed after v1 profile-height and v2 rear-ankle-width rejection. Source/refinement reused truthfully; original bodies, full item sources and late ownership remain separate.

structural_correction.profile: Continuous bands span upper foot contour to sole.
structural_correction.ankles: Curved front/rear bands span both ankle edges on actual fixed feet; target body-specific coverage checked.

actual_review.reason: Inspected male SEN and mirrored west: continuous profile bands cover the foot height and reach the sole, with front/rear ankle bands spanning both original ankle edges, crossed front straps and rear heel supports. Source/refinement reused from female v3; whole-foot horizontal fitting matches the original male foot bounds, keeping vertical contact and original skin unchanged. Native palette remains sole y / straps w with illustrative body C. No new ImageGen call, native acceptance or named mutation assembly.

Inspected corrected SEN/west footwear, source retry and neutral/native palette. Profile bands run over the instep and forefoot upper contour and down to the sole instead of terminating halfway up the foot. Front/rear ankle bands now span both original ankle edges, with direct body/visibility checks at the actual band rows. Open skin between straps and back heel supports remains intentional. Source/feet/contact unchanged; AI body/background rejected, neutral material used with explicit corrected geometry. No native validation or named mutation assembly credit.

Inspected older-human SEN and mirrored west: continuous profile bands cover the foot height and reach the sole, with front/rear ankle bands spanning both original ankle edges, crossed front straps and rear heel supports. Source/refinement reused from female v3; whole-foot horizontal fitting matches the original older-human foot bounds, keeping vertical contact and original skin unchanged. Native palette remains sole y / straps w with illustrative body C. No new ImageGen call, native acceptance or named mutation assembly.

Nima ordinary Feet/0 uses the same fixed unmutated female base and identical Sandals source/palette. Corrected full-width front/rear ankle bands and full-height SEN/profile/west straps, full soles and original foot masks are reused byte-for-byte; reviewed shared footwear and intended-size evidence applies exactly. No extra body or ImageGen call. Body C on shared color plate is illustrative; this is not acceptance of Nima individual body/tail/extra-arm or native outfit assembly.

palette: Native sole y / strap detail w. Body C in overview is illustrative and independent.
limits: Generation readiness only. Individual mutations, complete outfits and native acceptance remain pending the full-set gate. No new ImageGen or native test performed for aggregation.
